sentences.text: Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

-----
For the Petitioners : M/s. V. K. Rai, Advocate For the State : M/s. Someshwar Roy, A.P.P
---
04/20.03.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Chandankiyari P. S. Case No. 72/2022,
registered under Sections 341/ 323/ 324/ 326/ 307/ 498A/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 03/04 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of Ms. Divya Mishra, learned C.J.M., Bokaro.
Petitioners are in-laws of the informant.
It is alleged that on 25.04.2022 there was some altercation between the family members of the informant and the accused persons which resulted in a free fight.
For the same occurrence case and counter case has been registered, it was submitted that there is no specific allegation against the petitioners and they are ladies.
It was also submitted that there is general allegation against all the petitioners.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to them.

They are directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on their surrender shall release them on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Divya Mishra, learned C.J.M.,
Bokaro or her successor in connection with Chandankiyari P. S. Case No. 72/2022,
Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
